summary: Tested LUMI logo rendering, dashboard Recent Conversations panel, Pending Invites panel, and channel invite system. Fixed 2 backend bugs: typo 'declineed' -> 'declined' and missing requires_approval field persistence. All features working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: LumiBrand component correctly uses transparent logos for light backgrounds and dark logos for dark backgrounds
CreateChannelModal has proper 2-step flow: Step 1 (name, type, private, requires_approval) -> Step 2 (invite emails)
All data-testid attributes properly implemented across components
Dashboard shows Recent Conversations panel combining channels and DMs
seed_data_creation: Created test channels via backend tests (prefixed with TEST_)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Channel invite system fully tested: POST /api/lumi/channels with invite_emails and requires_approval, POST /api/lumi/channels/{id}/invite, GET /api/lumi/invites, POST /api/lumi/invites/{id}/respond. Frontend: Dashboard shows Recent Conversations + Pending Invites panels. CreateChannelModal has 2-step flow. Logo uses transparent PNG on light backgrounds.

tested_features.details: Uses transparent versions (lumi-bubble-transparent.png, lumi-logo-transparent.png) for light backgrounds and official versions for dark backgrounds. Verified on login page (dark bg), dashboard (dark bg), and empty channel state (white bg with text-light gradient).
Creates channel and sends invites to specified emails. Verified channel is created and invites appear in recipient's pending invites.
Creates channel with requires_approval flag. Fixed bug: field was not being persisted to database. Now correctly saved and checked in join flow.
Sends invites to users by email. Returns {sent: [], total: N}.
Returns pending invites for current user, matching either user_id or email.
Accept/decline invite. Fixed bug: 'decline' + 'ed' was producing 'declineed'. Now returns correct 'declined' status.
Returns {status: 'pending_approval'} for channels with requires_approval=true, creates join request record.
Shows combined list of channels and DMs with unread counts. Visible with data-testid='recent-conversations-panel'.
Shows when user has pending invites. Displays channel name, inviter name, Accept/Decline buttons. data-testid='pending-invites-panel'.
Clicking Accept adds user to channel, shows 'Invite accepted!' toast, channel appears in sidebar. Clicking Decline removes invite.
Step 1: Channel name, description, type (Group/Project/Announce), Private checkbox, Require approval checkbox. Step 2: Invite emails textarea. 'Next: Invite' button transitions between steps.
Uses LumiBrand text-light variant - gradient text 'LUMI' on white background without dark square artifact.

bugs_fixed.bug: requires_approval field not saved to channel
